page.layout: One page of running text, with two medallion portraits (woodcut coins) above it, centred. No margin notes. Printed page number top left, running head top centre.

main_text.head: GENSERICVS
main_text.p: GENSERICVS, Alanorum, Vandalorumque Rex ab Hispaniis euocatus à Bonifacio Africæ præfecto, in Libyam intromittitur, vt eidem Bonifacio aduersus Sigisuldũ siue Suuldum opem ferat, nam Bonifacius ille Africa vsurpare conabatur. Genfericus itaque cum suis Alanis & Vandalis tota pene Africam ferro, flamma, rapinis crudelissimè deuastans, catholicam insuper fidem Arriana impietate subuertit: anno mundi 4390. à Christo nato 428. post treis annos Hipponen obsedit: mense 3. obsidionis D. Augustinus, in illa ipsa vrbe cuius erat Episcopus, obiit annos natus 76. nec vrbis suæ ruinam vidit. Pom.Læt.Paul.Diac.li.14. Ab Vrsper.

ATTILA Hunnorum Rex omniúmq; Septentrionalium pene nationum, fratre suum occidit, eiusq; subditos sibi parere compulit. Hic Imperium Occidentale ambiens, ac Visigothis inuidęs, exercitum 500000. hominum comparauit: in Galliam irrupit: cum Ætio, Imperatoris vice gerente, & cum Theodorico Visigothorũ Rege, in campis Catalaunicis grauissimo prælio pugnauit: cæsa sunt 180000. (alij scribunt 200000.) vtrinque hominũ, inter quos Theodoricus: tantúmq; sanguinis effusum est, vt paruulus qui ibi labebatur riuulus, immodicus subito torrens effectus, cadauera secum traheret peremptorum. commissum est id prælium anno mundi 4414. post Christum natum 452. nullus pedè retulit, nullus retro vulnus accepit: tanta contentione pugnatum est. At superatus Attila, tandémq; resipiēs, Italiā peruasit furibundus, actúmq; effet de ea, ni Papa supplex illum adiēs, totius Italiæ salutem reportasset. Vxorem exinde duxit Imperatoris Valentiniani filiam, alias minitatus Imperatori: dein alteram duxit: cúmque nuptiarum die nimio se vino ingurgitasset, expirauit. Pau.Diac.li.15. Ab, Vrsper.

page.notes: Two woodcut medallion portraits above the text: left labelled "GEISE[RICVS]" (around the rim, partly legible as "RICVS" and "GEI S E"), right labelled "ATTILA". Their rim inscriptions are read from the scan and may be incomplete. The first main_text element above is a stray placeholder and should be ignored; the heading GENSERICVS is the first line of the paragraph and is printed as running text in capitals at the start of the paragraph, so it is included in that paragraph rather than as a heading. Passage "Sigisuldũ" and "Vrsper" are as printed. Possible misreadings: "Hipponen", "Catalaunicis" and the numerals are copied as printed.
